headline: AI Engineer Salary in Canada 2026: Toronto, Montreal & Vancouver Pay Guide
metaDescription: AI engineer salary Canada 2026: average CAD 99k-139k, entry 65-85k, senior 150-200k+. Toronto, Montreal and Vancouver bands, top employers and hiring tips.

sections.content:
Canada's AI engineering market pays well by global standards in 2026, with OECD analysis finding AI-skill postings pay about 11 percent more within the same firm. Machine learning engineers average roughly 99,000 to 139,000 Canadian dollars nationally, while Indeed's July 2026 data reports an average base of 140,514 dollars across 65 salaries.

Total compensation often adds equity, bonuses and remote stipends. Remote work has opened US employer salary bands to Canada-based engineers, pushing the upper ceiling for senior talent far above in-office numbers. Toronto sits highest for in-office roles at about 150,000 dollars average.
sections.title: Average AI Engineer Pay in Canada for 2026

sections.content:
Entry-level engineers with zero to two years earn 65,000 to 85,000 dollars in-office, or 85,000 to 110,000 dollars remote. Mid-level engineers with three to six years earn 90,000 to 130,000 dollars in-office, or 120,000 to 170,000 dollars remote.

Senior engineers with seven or more years earn 150,000 to 200,000 dollars in-office, with remote seniors at US-paying employers reaching 180,000 to 300,000 dollars. Montreal reports the highest Indeed averages near 181,000 dollars, followed by Markham and Toronto.
sections.title: Salary by Experience Level

sections.content:
The highest payers include banks like Interac, chip firms like AMD, and product companies like Shopify, which reports ML packages around 202,500 dollars. Meta, Clio and fintech employers also sit near the top of Canadian bands, and levels.fyi data puts median Toronto AI engineer total compensation at 138,000 dollars.

Montreal offsets slightly lower base pay with world-class research mentorship through institutes like Mila, attractive for researchers early in their careers. Vancouver's senior ML roles average around 144,000 dollars in the city's growing tech scene.
sections.title: Top-Paying Employers and Cities

sections.content:
Canada's Global Talent Stream processes work permits in about two weeks for AI engineers under Category B, one of the fastest skilled routes anywhere. Express Entry remains the main path to permanent residency, and Canadian tech immigration is far more predictable than the US H-1B lottery.

For engineers already in Canada, the fastest pay gains come from specializing in scarce areas such as LLM systems, evaluation and ML infrastructure, plus negotiating between competing offers. Certifications clear recruiter screens but the premium concentrates in demonstrated engineering output.
